complexity.description: Parameters, GFLOPs and model size per architecture profile and input size

latency.description: Batch-1 latency with preprocess / forward / postprocess breakdown (p50/p95/p99)

memory.description: Peak RAM (CPU, RSS) or VRAM (CUDA, allocated) for inference and a training step, one fresh process per profile
memory.metric: process RSS (MB), fresh process per profile

training.description: Training step time and images/second (synthetic batch, AdamW)

startup.description: Checkpoint load time, first-request penalty and warm latency

onnx.description: ONNX export, numerical parity and ONNX Runtime vs PyTorch latency

api.description: Requests/second and latency percentiles of /v1/predict under concurrent clients

e2e.description: Train + validate on a seeded synthetic dataset (pipeline correctness and learning signal)

robustness.description: mAP50 retention under Gaussian noise, blur, brightness/contrast, JPEG and downscaling
robustness.note: mAP50 here is a per-class AP50 mean computed in-process (compute_per_class_ap), not COCO-style.

accuracy.description: Precision/recall/mAP50/mAP50-95/IoU on a dataset split via validate.py (needs --weights and --data-yaml)
accuracy.skipped: pass --weights and --data-yaml to enable the accuracy suite
